# Disease classifier model card: disease_best.keras

## Purpose
Classifies an accepted leaf photo as healthy or one of three foliar diseases, with a confidence, as one input to fusion.

## Version and files
- Version: disease-v1
- File: disease_best.keras (33420901 bytes)
- sha256: 14789a72957ec68bb73874e9b184b2e61b7dca68f0795354dcbec9f8e753acb4
- Weights are not in git. Location: MyDrive/maize-project/models/core_classifier/checkpoints/disease_best.keras
- TensorFlow 2.21.0. Input: 224x224 RGB, preprocessing "efficientnet".
- Classes, in model output order: common_rust, gray_leaf_spot, healthy, northern_leaf_blight.

## Data
PlantVillage maize images (controlled conditions), split into train, validation and test. Train images per class: common_rust 912, gray_leaf_spot 401, healthy 811, northern_leaf_blight 798. Validation images per class: common_rust 195, gray_leaf_spot 86, healthy 173, northern_leaf_blight 171. Test n = 631.

## Training
Source: `models/core_classifier/training_run.json`, trained with `scripts/train_image_classifier.py` in Colab. EfficientNetB0 with ImageNet weights, two phases: head only (8 epochs allowed, learning rate 0.001), then the last 40 base layers unfrozen with BatchNormalization kept frozen (12 epochs allowed, learning rate 1e-05). Epochs actually run: phase 1 8, phase 2 6 (early stopping). Batch size 32, seed 42, balanced class weights, TensorFlow 2.21.0. Best validation accuracy 0.9616. The checkpoint was chosen on validation, so validation figures are optimistic.

## Test results (single evaluation, n = 631)
Source: `results/disease_best/disease_v1_test/metrics.json`. Accuracy 0.9223, macro F1 0.9020. The test split was evaluated once and not used for any tuning.

| Class | Precision | Recall | Support |
|---|---|---|---|
| common_rust | 0.9896 | 0.9695 | 197 |
| gray_leaf_spot | 0.7245 | 0.8161 | 87 |
| healthy | 1.0000 | 0.9943 | 175 |
| northern_leaf_blight | 0.8795 | 0.8488 | 172 |

Safety property: diseased leaves called healthy 0.0000; healthy leaves called diseased 0.0057.

## Thresholds
- System threshold `t_disease` = 0.6. This is the RAP fusion bound below which a result is uncertain.
- Operating point selected on the validation split by a rule fixed beforehand: 0.55. Fusion overrides it with the stricter value above.
- At 0.6 on the validation split: coverage 0.9472, accuracy on accepted images 0.9780, diseased leaves accepted as healthy 0.
- At the same threshold on the test split: coverage 0.9366, accuracy on accepted images 0.9526.
- Validation threshold table: `results/disease_best/disease_v1_val/threshold_table.csv`.

## Known failure modes
- Gray leaf spot and northern leaf blight are confused with each other: 15 gray leaf spot images called northern leaf blight, 25 the other way round (test split). Both are foliar diseases, so a sick leaf is still flagged as sick, but the disease label, and therefore the advice, can be wrong.
- Gray leaf spot has the lowest confidence: about one validation photo in five asks for a retake at the system threshold.

## Limitations
- PlantVillage images are photographed under controlled conditions. No real-world test of this model has been run, so performance on phone photos is unknown and likely lower.
- A perceptual-hash leakage check between train and test found no near-duplicate pairs. Its console output was not saved as a file (`docs/limitations.md`, section Disease classifier). It catches near-identical images only.
- Covers three foliar diseases and healthy leaves. Other diseases, pests and deficiencies are not recognised.
